summary: The Admin rail's Specs and docs group carries `UI Specs v2`, which opens the v2 draft pages in a new tab through a new internal door that redirects, and the Project Spec submenu no longer carries the departing Docs row.
reader_impact: An admin finds `UI Specs v2` in the rail and one click opens the draft docs in a marked new tab; the Project Spec submenu has no second door to the same pages.
